# Policy-KB bijection audit — d3_ship_to_orders_backorders_and_returns / task 1

## revision_1

Scope: extended policies order_ext_requested_move_up (root) and order_ext_reactivation_level (prerequisite); governing base policies order_ship_to_lifecycle and order_agg_ship_to_portfolio (plus order_ship_to_setup, which cites the portfolio clause). The full product base/variant sweep is recorded in 0.md and holds here too. Source read after both blind answers were frozen.

## source_to_kb

### order_ext_requested_move_up
- Hub `customer_elected_service_level_moves`: requested move up recorded on the customer's election; prerequisite section; overwrite #2 replaced_by (entry gates on own trailing 12 month spend, new-ship-to portfolio exception, "and except that a requested move up decided under this rule, and only such a move, is measured on the move-up measure against the next level's entry gate as applied under this rule") in force; customer tool section = task_tools contract (user-owned; stamps the change date in `last_review_date`).
- Prerequisite (form state, value_input on held_level_now): policy_source "A requested move up is not decided until the ship-to's status is active." — verbatim under "When a move up is decided", plus a same-form restatement ("while the ship-to's status is anything other than active, a requested move up is not decided"). Connective "not … until", strength hard, form state — match. Not in any reactivation document (grep "not decided": hub only). Resolution basis: the reactivation desk card describes the write in the sentence's own words ("the reactivation brings the delivery location back to active status"; tool "sets the delivery location's status to active") + record status suspended; the level then read is the reactivated level (ranking doc). Authoring fields have no prose home.
- Baseline → `move_up_measure_and_next_level_gate`: rule 1 = overwrite #1 replaced_by; rule 2 next level/gate (5000.00, 25000.00); rules 3–5 twelve-month site spend, whole months, at-or-above moves up, to the cent; rule 6 StockSmart / VendPoint never count. Generic assembly sentence (shares in one product) → rule 7.
- Factors, full ladders: site_ordering_basis (method) → `ordering_pattern_move_up_measure` (coming back: last active year × 12 / (D + 12), no last order date 0.00; newly opened < 12 whole months: × 12 / months open, at least 1, no opened date 0; otherwise not measured either way); commitment_gate_share → `spend_commitment_share_move_up_gate` (88 ≥ 150000.00; 94 60000.00–149999.99; full); standing_gate_share → `payment_record_share_move_up_gate` (95 active + none in 24; 97 active + in 24 but not 12; full otherwise); terms_gate_share → `terms_tier_share_move_up_gate` (90 Net 60 Corporate / Net 90 Strategic; 94 Net 30 Preferred / Net 45 Business; full for the other tiers — the table's Net 10 Starter and Net 30 Standard are the credit product's two remaining tiers per the blueprint — or no account); credit_tenure_gate_share → `credit_account_tenure_share_move_up_gate` (95 ≥ 120; 97 60–119; full). All match; each names the Contract Pricing Agreement / Commercial Credit Account and its record words.
- Overwrites: #1 lifecycle move-up clause written retired (quoted) in `ship_to_suspension_level_change_closure`; #2 portfolio entry-gate clause written "(clause no longer in force)" (quoted) in `ship_to_portfolio_principles`; the other portfolio principles (stand-alone ship-tos, one billing account) in force.

### order_ext_reactivation_level
- Hub `suspended_ship_to_reactivation_desk_card`: no orders while suspended; agent reactivates at the customer's request, credit account active (system record); tool section = contract (status active + level supplied).
- Prerequisite: none declared; none rendered.
- Baseline → `reactivated_service_level_ranking`: clause 1 = overwrite replaced_by; clause 2 prior level / no drop restores; clause 3 ranking and one place per drop, floor Parcel. Generic assembly sentence (drops added, take-backs subtracted, net never below zero, adjustment on the net total) → clause 4.
- Factors: dormancy_level_drops → `dormancy_level_drops_reactivation` (2 ≥ 30; 1 for 18–29; none < 18 / no last order date); lost_route_drops → `route_truck_use_last_active_year` (route level: 0 runs → 2, 1–5 → 1, ≥ 6 none; non-route / no last order date none; window D … D + 12); payment_level_drops → `payment_record_drops_reactivation` (returned payments + finance charges together, ≥ 2 → 2, 1 → 1; other charge types excluded); stocksmart_takeback → `active_stocksmart_program_reactivation_takeback` (active Onsite Storeroom 2, other active tier 1, none otherwise; non-active statuses never read); tenure_adjustment (method) → `long_tenure_treatment_reactivation_drops` (≥ 180 halved down; 96–179 minus one, floor 0; otherwise none; no opened date 0 months). All complete.
- Overwrite: lifecycle reactivation clause written retired (quoted) in `ship_to_suspension_level_change_closure`; replaced_by in force in clause 1 of the ranking doc. Lifecycle suspension and closure clauses in force.

- Prerequisite-side checks: no cross-problem operational guidance (the reactivation tool is named only in the reactivation hub; the election tool only in the move-up hub); no opening world state as policy fact (no Twinsburg/Marlowe/ship-to/date of the task in any document).

## bijection_verdict
**PASS.**

Source-side item (not a KB defect; for src=):
- **SRC-3 (base clause cites a clause its sibling overwrite retires).** Base order_ship_to_setup: "at the requested service level when its entry gate is met (including the portfolio allowance in order_agg_ship_to_portfolio)". The move-up overwrite #2 retires that portfolio clause and carries the allowance on in its replaced_by. The KB renders both faithfully: `new_ship_to_setup_conditions` says "including the portfolio allowance under the ship-to portfolio principles", while `ship_to_portfolio_principles` writes the clause "no longer in force … superseded by the current basis", and the in-force allowance stands only in `customer_elected_service_level_moves`. A setup reader is pointed to a retired text. No task in this difficulty exercises setup.

## dependency_form
- Prerequisite sentence verbatim on the blocked side in its declared state form, with a same-form restatement — not RED; the sentence does not name reactivation, its performer or its tool. Absent from the reactivation documents.
- The reactivation documents are reached through the sentence's own state words ("status", "active", "suspended") and the ship-to record's status field — not through phrasing borrowed from the move-up hub.
- No route, checklist, aggregated chain, cross-problem example or wrong-vs-right contrast. `anniversary_review_spend_test` §1 "a move up on the customer's request remains under the rule for requested moves" is the anniversary overwrite's own replaced_by (source scope sentence), not an added dependency.
- Titles general ("Customer-Elected Service Level Moves for Ship-To Fulfillment Accounts", "Reactivation of Suspended Ship-To Fulfillment Accounts", "Long Dormancy and the Reactivated Service Level of a Ship-To", …).
- Factor documents name no other factor and no computation document. Observation O-1 (placement, stop rule): the ranking clause 4 and move-up rule 7 generic assembly sentences, sourced verbatim from the rules; the dormancy and payment-record factor documents each repeat "Each level drop moves the reactivated level one place down the service level ranking", a restatement of the baseline ranking rule, not a pointer.
- **PASS.**

Part verdicts (task 1): runtime PASS; bijection PASS; dependency_form PASS.

### Exhaustive other-product pass (revision_5, both worlds, one pass)

Method: a scripted check of every other-product row in both worlds against the published rules, plus a hand reading of each rule family.

**Credit, checked row by row:**
- every invoice against its source record (order shipment by order, date and shipment; order service fee; StockSmart scan order; StockSmart fee), and every source record against an invoice;
- due date = invoice date + net days; invoice totals; freight;
- payment application; the prompt-payment discount window; the certified-funds period;

- agreement proposal window, first term, renewal, entry gate and anniversary shortfall review;
